faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.q1: What core services does MatchBest Group provide?
faq.a1: We specialize in AI Automation, Custom Software Development, Cloud Solutions, and Digital Transformation for startups and enterprises worldwide.
faq.a2: Our headquarters is located in tower-B3, Spaze I-Tech Park, Sohna Road, Sector-49, Gurugram (India), serving clients globally with top-tier tech solutions.
faq.q3: How do I start a project with MatchBest?
faq.a3: Simply click the 'Contact' button or email us. We start with a free consultation to understand your needs and provide a tailored roadmap.
faq.q4: Does MatchBest Group work with startups?
faq.a4: Yes! We love startups. We offer scalable MVP development and flexible engagement models specifically designed for early-stage growth.
faq.q5: What technologies do you use for development?
faq.a5: We use modern tech stacks including React, Next.js, Node.js, Python (AI/ML), Java Spring Boot, and cloud platforms like AWS and Azure.

faq.q7: How do you ensure data security?
faq.a7: We follow strict security protocols including NDA signing, data encryption, and secure cloud compliance to protect your intellectual property.
faq.q8: Can I hire developers for a specific duration?
faq.a8: Yes, we offer 'Staff Augmentation' services where you can hire our expert developers on a monthly or project basis.
